name: AgentFilings
description: Structured US SEC/EDGAR filing data for autonomous agents: filings index, XBRL-derived earnings summaries, and Form 4 insider transactions as clean JSON. Public-domain SEC data, pre-parsed and normalized. Paid endpoints use x402 (USDC on Base); /health and /probe are free. Call /probe first to check coverage and pricing before paying.
